a: Simple requests (some GET/POST) skip preflight under limited conditions.
Browsers send OPTIONS preflight for non-simple cross-origin requests.
Reflect a specific origin (not *) when credentials are used.
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true enables cookies on cross-origin calls.
List allowed request headers in Access-Control-Allow-Headers.
Expose non-simple response headers the JS client needs to read.
Overly broad * with credentials or reflecting any Origin is dangerous.
SameSite cookies and CORS solve different cross-site problems.
Check browser console Network tab for preflight failures and missing headers.
